Joint Multi-Lag Trajectory Modeling and Operator-Informed Inference for MEDuSA

Source: R/diagnose_crossrun_recovery.R
medusa_multilag_infer.Rd

Replaces independent lag-by-lag post-hoc testing in MEDuSA Stage 4 with a unified multi-lag estimation and inference framework that exploits the exact Stage-2/3 cross-lag point-spread resolution matrix \(C_{\mathrm{sym}}\) and cross-lag operator error correlation \(R_{\mathrm{op}}\):

  1. Lobe-Normalized Spectral Lavrentiev–Tikhonov Cross-Lag De-Blurring + Correlated-SURE 2nd-Order Boosted P-Spline Smoothing: sharpens multiphasic and ramped within-trial neural waveforms without boundary distortion or interior gain inflation.

  2. Multivariate Empirical Bayes (EB) Subject Trajectory Shrinkage: borrows strength across all \(L\) lags simultaneously via the between-subject trajectory covariance \(\hat{\Sigma}_b\) and subject-specific cross-lag error covariance \(\hat{\Sigma}_{e,s}\).

  3. Operator-Informed Simultaneous Cross-Lag Inference: calibrates epoch-wide family-wise error rate (FWER) via exact correlated multivariate-\(t\) Max-\(|T|\) simultaneous confidence bands (p_maxT, conf.low.sim, conf.high.sim) and 1D Threshold-Free Cluster Enhancement (tfce_stat, p_tfce), avoiding the severe conservatism of Bonferroni/BY-FDR under strong positive cross-lag correlation.

  4. Continuous Sub-Grid Spline Latency & Shape Estimation: estimates continuous peak latency (peak_lag), center-of-mass latency (com_lag), and full-width at half-maximum (fwhm) with parametric-bootstrap SEs and confidence intervals.

Usage

medusa_multilag_infer(
  data,
  covariates = NULL,
  lag_resolution = NULL,
  lag_error_cor = NULL,
  trajectory_mode = c("auto", "deblur_pspline", "pspline", "deblur", "none"),
  use_whitened = TRUE,
  tr = 1,
  readout_kernel = "triangle",
  readout_width = 1.5,
  decon_lambda = 0.8,
  rho_ar1 = 0.3,
  demix_within_trial = FALSE,
  recalibrate_wt_lobe = FALSE,
  contrasts = NULL,
  contrast_source = c("unsmoothed", "raw", "multilag"),
  n_perm = 4000L,
  n_boot_latency = 400L,
  fine_dt = 0.01,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  polarity = c("positive", "negative", "abs"),
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Either: (a) a decon_epoch_regression result list (or a list of per-subject decon_epoch_regression results), (b) a trial-level MEDuSA panel data.frame/data.table (single-subject or multi-subject), or (c) a lag-level coefficient table with columns lag (or evt_time), estimate (or beta_corrected), and std.error (or se_corrected).

covariates

Optional character vector of covariate names when data is a trial-level panel. If NULL, inferred automatically from panel columns.

lag_resolution

Optional named list (by region/parcel/voxel) of \(L \times L\) cross-lag resolution matrices \(C_{\mathrm{sym}}\), or a single \(L \times L\) matrix.

lag_error_cor

Optional named list (by region/parcel/voxel) of \(L \times L\) operator cross-lag error correlation matrices \(R_{\mathrm{op}}\), or a single matrix.

trajectory_mode

Trajectory estimation mode: "auto" (default; applies spectral cross-lag de-blurring when !demix_within_trial followed by correlated-SURE boosted P-spline smoothing), "deblur_pspline", "pspline", "deblur", or "none".

use_whitened

Logical; if TRUE (default) and whitened columns (decon_demixed_whitened, *_whitened) are present in a trial panel, uses them for within-subject lag regressions.

tr

Acquisition TR in seconds (default 1.0), used when constructing reference cross-lag operators if lag_resolution is not attached.

readout_kernel

Readout kernel ("triangle", "boxcar", "gaussian", "linear") for reference operator construction.

readout_width

Readout kernel width in seconds (default 1.5).

decon_lambda

Reference deconvolution penalty \(\lambda\) (default 0.8).

rho_ar1

Reference AR(1) parameter (default 0.30).

demix_within_trial

Logical indicating whether Stage-3 within-trial cross-lag de-mixing was already applied to the input panel/coefficients (default FALSE).

recalibrate_wt_lobe

Logical; if TRUE and demix_within_trial = TRUE, recalibrates interior vs. boundary lobe gain on W_lag.

contrasts

Optional named list of lag contrast specifications. Each entry can be either a numeric weight vector of length \(L\) or a list list(early = c(t1, t2), late = c(t3, t4)) specifying two lag windows to contrast (late - early).

contrast_source

Trajectory source for linear window contrasts: "unsmoothed" (default; evaluates contrasts on the cross-lag de-blurred trajectory prior to P-spline smoothing so contrast point estimates and CIs are free of P-spline shrinkage bias), "raw" (raw lag-by-lag estimates), or "multilag" (P-spline smoothed trajectory).

n_perm

Number of correlated Monte Carlo studentized draws for simultaneous Max-\(|T|\), 1D TFCE, and omnibus calibration (default 4000L).

n_boot_latency

Number of parametric bootstrap draws for continuous spline latency SEs and confidence intervals (default 400L).

fine_dt

Sub-grid spline evaluation step in seconds (default 0.01).

conf_level

Simultaneous and pointwise confidence level (default 0.95).

polarity

Peak polarity for latency extraction ("positive", "negative", or "abs").

seed

Optional random seed for reproducible Monte Carlo / bootstrap draws.

Value

An object of class "medusa_multilag" containing:

coefficients

data.table of group/unit lag estimates (estimate, std.error, estimate_multilag, std.error_multilag), pointwise \(t\)/\(p\)-values, FDR-adjusted \(p\)-values (p_fdr_bh, p_fdr_by), simultaneous Max-\(|T|\) \(p\)-values and confidence bands (p_maxT, conf.low.sim, conf.high.sim), 1D TFCE statistics and family-wise \(p\)-values (tfce_stat, p_tfce), and epoch omnibus tests (omnibus_stat, omnibus_p).

latency

data.table of continuous sub-grid spline peak latency (peak_lag, peak_lag_se, peak_lag_conf.low, peak_lag_conf.high), discrete grid peak (peak_lag_grid), center-of-mass latency (com_lag, com_lag_se), and FWHM (fwhm, fwhm_se) per unit and term.

contrasts

data.table of covariance-propagated multi-lag window contrasts (estimate, std.error, statistic, df, p.value, conf.low, conf.high).

subjects

data.table of subject-specific lag trajectories (estimate_raw, estimate_smooth, and Multivariate Empirical Bayes estimate_eb) when multi-subject data are supplied.

subject_latency

data.table of subject-specific continuous spline peak and center-of-mass latencies extracted from estimate_eb.

covariance

Nested list of \(L \times L\) raw and multi-lag trajectory covariance and correlation matrices per unit and term.
